details.prevention: Acquire a common lock order; cleanup uses lockInterruptibly and finally unlock.

details.operation: Compound increment is protected by a manual lock or ConcurrentHashMap.merge.
details.timingCaveat: One measured sample per variant; no statistical claim or guaranteed speedup.

details.executor: Explicit bounded-size executor; no implicit common pool.

details.io: Blocking loopback TCP request/read; scheduled server response
details.latencyScope: Immediately before submit until the matching TCP response
details.resourceScope: Whole JVM, including the loopback server and sampler; modes run sequentially

resources.cpuMetric: process CPU time delta / wall time delta / logical processors * 100

virtual.reason: Virtual threads require JDK 21+; current runtime is 17.0.2

limitations: Teaching experiments run in one independent JVM, not the business order pipeline.
Timing varies with JIT, CPU scheduling and other programs; no fixed speedup is asserted.
Blocking I/O comparison uses local TCP, including queue time, rather than MySQL workload.
JDK17 skips virtual threads; virtual results require an actual JDK21+ run.
